description: Run a compiled .PR program against every record in a data file. Like CHAPRPG from the original SCIOS. Use this for scoring, bulk updates, conditional logic across records.

program.description: Compiled program name (.PR) in the same project

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

where.description: Optional filter — only run against matching records

op.description: Operator: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, between, contains, starts_with

where_logic.description: How to combine multiple where conditions (default: and)

name: chaprola_run_each
